Dimensionality reduction for RNA-seq data (PCA, UMAP, t-SNE)

rna_dimred.Rd

Performs dimensionality reduction on normalized RNA-seq expression data stored in the active rna_project, generating low-dimensional representations of samples using Principal Component Analysis (PCA), Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection (UMAP), and optionally t-distributed Stochastic Neighbor Embedding (t-SNE).

The function automatically adapts parameters based on dataset size and structure, and returns both numerical results and publication-ready plots.

Usage

rna_dimred(
  project,
  group_col = "Group",
  run_tsne = FALSE,
  add_ellipse = FALSE,
  ellipse_level = 0.95,
  colors = NULL,
  ncomp_pca = NULL,
  n_neighbors = NULL,
  tsne_perplexity = 30,
  use_pca_preprocessing = TRUE,
  pca_method = "auto",
  pca_var_threshold = 0.8,
  pca_max_dims = 50,
  pca_min_dims = 10,
  point_size = 2,
  seed = NULL,
  save = TRUE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

project

rna_project object created by rna_project().

group_col

Character. Metadata column used to define sample groups for coloring plots (default: "Group").

run_tsne

Logical. Whether to compute t-SNE embeddings (default: FALSE).

add_ellipse

Logical. If TRUE, adds confidence ellipses to PCA plot when group sizes allow (default: FALSE).

ellipse_level

Numeric. Confidence level for PCA ellipses (default: 0.95).

colors

Character. Optional point colors.

ncomp_pca

Integer. Maximum number of PCA components to compute. If NULL, uses the maximum possible (default).

n_neighbors

Integer. Number of neighbors for UMAP. If NULL, automatically set based on sample size.

tsne_perplexity

Numeric. Initial perplexity for t-SNE (automatically adjusted if too large; default: 30).

use_pca_preprocessing

Logical. Whether to use PCA-reduced space as input for UMAP and t-SNE (default: TRUE).

pca_method

Character. Strategy for selecting number of PCs:

  • "auto": selects PCs based on cumulative variance threshold

  • "variance": selects PCs reaching pca_var_threshold

  • "fixed": uses ncomp_pca directly

pca_var_threshold

Numeric. Target cumulative variance explained when using adaptive PCA selection (default: 0.8).

pca_max_dims

Integer. Maximum number of PCs allowed (default: 50).

pca_min_dims

Integer. Minimum number of PCs enforced (default: 10).

point_size

Numeric. Size of points in plots (default: 2).

seed

Optional integer used to set the random seed for reproducibility. If NULL, the existing random number generator state is used.

save

Logical. Whether to store results in the active rna_project (default: TRUE).

verbose

Logical. If TRUE, prints progress messages and displays plots (default: TRUE).

Value

An object of class "dimred_result" containing:

res_dimred

List with dimensionality reduction results:

  • summary: dataset overview (samples, genes, grouping, seed and rng state)

  • preprocessing: PCA preprocessing parameters

  • PCA: PCA model, variance explained, loadings, coordinates

  • UMAP: UMAP model, coordinates, and parameters

  • tSNE: t-SNE model and coordinates (if computed)

plots

List of ggplot2 objects: PCA, UMAP, and optionally tSNE

Details

The function expects normalized expression data available in rna_project$data$normalized_data, including:

  • expr_matrix: gene expression matrix (genes x samples)

  • metadata: sample metadata

Internally, the expression matrix is transposed so that samples are treated as observations.

Adaptive behavior:

  • UMAP neighbors are set to floor(n_samples / 2) when unspecified

  • t-SNE perplexity is capped at floor((n_samples - 1)/3)

  • t-SNE is skipped when n_samples < 6

  • PCA dimensionality is automatically selected when use_pca_preprocessing = TRUE

Interpretation notes:

  • PCA captures global variance structure and is deterministic

  • UMAP emphasizes local structure and clustering

  • t-SNE is stochastic and sensitive to parameter choice

Stored output

When save = TRUE, results are stored in: rna_project$analyses$dimred, enabling reproducibility and reuse.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Run default dimensionality reduction
rna_dimred(project = my_project)

# Run with t-SNE and ellipses
rna_dimred(my_project,
           run_tsne = TRUE,
           add_ellipse = TRUE)
} # }
